subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Ask for and give personal information clearly.
Give longer answers with reasons and examples.
Use linking words: because, as, one reason is, for example, but, so, also.

tf.s: Your surname is your family name.
tf.why: The surname is the family name at the end of your full name.

tf.s: A good interview answer is usually just one or two words.
tf.why: Good answers are fuller, with reasons and examples.

tf.s: 'Because', 'as' and 'one reason is' introduce a reason.

tf.why: 'For example' introduces an example, not a reason.

tf.s: In Ex 3, Chen gives better answers than Huda.
tf.why: His answers are fuller and more descriptive.

tf.s: A postcode is a type of email address.
tf.why: A postcode is part of your home address.

tf.s: We use 'but' to show a contrast.
tf.why: For example: It's a big city, but it's not the capital.

tf.s: 'How do you spell your surname?' asks someone to say the letters of their name.
tf.why: Spelling means saying the letters one by one.

tf.s: You should share your personal information with anyone online.
tf.why: Share personal information only when it is safe and appropriate.

tf.s: Your middle name always comes after your surname.
tf.why: The middle name comes between your first name and surname.

boxes.q: Complete: ___ do you get to school every day?
boxes.why: 'How' asks about the way you travel.

boxes.q: Complete: It's a big city, ___ it's not the capital.
Complete: I take the bus ___ the bus stop is near my house.
Order the words: middle / 's / your / what / name / ?
boxes.why: Question word first, then 's, then your middle name.

boxes.q: In Ex 5, whose answer is better?
boxes.why: This time Huda gives the fuller answer.

boxes.q: Which question asks about a place?
Complete: I love music. I ___ play the guitar.
Complete: It was raining, ___ we stayed at home.

o: A short list of facts about a person
boxes.why: A fact file collects key facts about someone.

mcq.q: Which of these introduce a reason?
How do you ask someone to spell the name of their town?
o: How do you spell the name of the town?
What do you spell the town?
mcq.why: 'How do you spell ...?' asks for the letters.

mcq.q: Why does Chen give the best answers in Ex 3?
o: His answers are fuller and more descriptive
mcq.why: He adds details, like where Guangzhou is.

o: A code that is part of your address
mcq.why: A postcode helps letters reach your address.

mcq.q: Complete: I'm keen on baking. ___, I make bread for my family once a week.
mcq.why: The second sentence gives an example of baking.

mcq.q: Which answer to 'Where do you live?' is the best?
o: I live in Sohar. It's a busy city by the sea, and I like its parks.
mcq.why: A full answer adds a description and a reason.

mcq.q: Complete: My favourite subject is science ___ I like doing experiments.
mcq.why: The second part gives the reason.

mcq.q: Huda says only 'I like swimming.' What is the best way to improve her answer?
o: Add a reason: 'I like swimming because it helps me relax.'
mcq.why: Reasons and examples make answers stronger.

mcq.q: Why is it good to extend your answers in a speaking test?
o: It shows you can give reasons, examples and details
It means you don't need to listen
mcq.why: Fuller answers show more of your English.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses linking words correctly?
o: I like football because it keeps me fit, and I also enjoy swimming.
I like football but because it is fun.
I like football so for example it's fun.
I like football also but swimming.
mcq.why: Because gives a reason and also adds information.
